title: Indonesia 🇮🇩 facts that sound fake but are true
headline: *Indonesia* sounds fake
description: Four Indonesia facts that sound made up but are real, each checked on Wikipedia. Which one did you know? Comment the number.
source: Wikipedia: Komodo dragon, Rafflesia arnoldii, Indonesia, Kopi luwak. Photos: Wikimedia Commons

id.title: Fakta Indonesia 🇮🇩 yang terdengar palsu tapi nyata
id.description: Empat fakta Indonesia yang terdengar dibuat-buat tapi nyata. Mana yang sudah kamu tahu? Tulis nomornya di komentar.

segments.text: Dragons are real. They live in Indonesia.
The biggest flower on Earth grows there too.
The country is made of more than seventeen thousand islands.
And one of the priciest coffees comes from beans eaten by civets.
